handling.role: All 11 focus groups form a cross-domain evaluation corpus held out from prompt, packet-rule, router, threshold, and stopping-rule development.
handling.identity: Speaker labels are normalized only within an FGD; the same label in different files is not assumed to be the same participant.
handling.privacy: The deposit is public, participant-numbered, and selectively redacted, but exact text and contextual details remain potentially identifiable. Do not describe it as anonymized.
handling.release: Do not publish transcript text or rater excerpts without a separate two-person privacy and permissions review, even though the source deposit is CC BY 4.0.
